newsitem.title: JORDAN: Peugeot outlook for Euro sales edges up.
newsitem.headline: Peugeot outlook for Euro sales edges up.

text.p: PSA Peugeot Citroen Chairman Jacques Calvet said he expected car sales in western Europe to rise one percent this year.
At a presentation of the Peugeot 406 coupe, Calvet said he was "slightly less pessimistic than three months ago", when he was expecting a 0.5 percent rise in sales.

For France, however, he still expects a 10 to 11 percent fall in 1997 sales. He said sales growth in Europe would be led by Italy, Britain and Spain, adding that Germany's results in the first two months of the year were slightly disappointing.
